We will not lose to this rabble!|The technician and Governor Pryce|audio=Rabble-Zero-Hour.flac|}} An [[Imperial Navy]] '''technician''' served aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Chimaera]]'' during the [[Battle of Atollon]]. During the battle, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] forces, including [[Ezra Bridger]] and [[Sabine Wren]], boarded the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Interdictor-class heavy cruiser|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[Constrainer]]''. The [[technician]] informed the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} temporary [[commanding officer]], [[Governor of the Lothal sector|Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce|Pryce]], that the [[strike team]] had boarded the [[Interdictor]]. Pryce then asked the technician to repel them, prompting the deployment of Imperial [[jumptrooper]]s onto the ''Constrainer''{{'s}} [[hull]]. ==Behind the scenes== The technician appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[Zero Hour]]," the finale of the series' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]]. The episode was released on [[March 25]], [[2017]] over two parts, the twenty-first and twenty-second episodes of the season overall.{{InsiderCite|174|Star Wars Rebels Season Three Episode Guide|''Star Wars Rebels'' Season Three Episode Guide}} In the episode, the technician was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker ]] and credited as "Imperial Technician." ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Zero Hour}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Seventh Fleet personnel]] [[Category:Technicians of the Galactic Empire]]
